evidence: Numerical maintained-bath capture controls. No closed aggregation, moisture depletion, full lunar column or empirical snow validation.
reading_rule: Distribution, moments, accounting and truncation are separate gates. Analytical tail and finite-ladder bounds exclude reconstruction, source quadrature and floating-point errors. Physical exits stop at first crossing. Poisson controls sample each grid at its own first face; the initial 191-cell setting matches the earlier crossing. The physical reference uses 8192 independent event histories and unbiased sample variance. Its 95% DKW band is uniform in mass at each time separately, not joint across controls or a numerical convergence bound. The execution history binds the initial incomplete matrix and identifies the one-worker continuation; its larger wall-time allowance changes no numerical setting.

execution_history.rule: Retained runs are unchanged JSON values from the source-verified initial attempt. Only unfinished controls are recomputed. Settings, numerical method and admission gates remain unchanged.
